title: Allow-list must equal the set of Scorer-defining modules; a completeness test guards drift
answers: new ragas or deepeval scorer module fails to deserialize as not in the allow-list
add scorer module to third-party allow-list
body:
Invariant: THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py lists exactly the modules under the four third-party packages (trulens, ragas, deepeval, phoenix) that define Scorer subclasses. Exact-match checking means a missing module cannot be reached through its parent package.
Enforced at: tests/genai/scorers/test_serialization.py (completeness test), which AST-scans the four packages and requires the allow-list to equal the set of Scorer-defining modules.
What breaks if skipped: a newly added scorer module is rejected at deserialization time with 'not in the allow-list', and the stored scorer cannot be reloaded.
Constraints: after adding a scorer module, add its dotted path to the frozenset in the same change. Do not solve it by restoring prefix matching.
applies: Adding or moving scorer modules under mlflow/genai/scorers/ragas, deepeval, trulens, or phoenix.
says: Saved evaluation metrics fail to load with an error stating scorer is not permitted
Newly added third-party evaluation metric cannot be reloaded from storage
Evaluation run fails to restore saved scores from supported external libraries
Allow new evaluation metrics from external packages to load successfully in experiments
Stored generative AI evaluation model fails to reload after completing an assessment run

A completeness test in tests/genai/scorers/test_serialization.py AST-scans those packages to ensure the allow-list equals the Scorer modules, preventing deserialization failures.
